packageRules.description: fedora base image major bumps are IGNORED (not even proposed): the fedora:46/rawhide image's dnf repos serve fc45-built packages with a keyring mismatch, breaking container builds. automerge:false alone did not stop renovate (tacklebox #209/#211); ignore prevents PR creation. Remove once the upstream image is consistent.

semantic-release 26 requires Node >=26.13 but the ubuntu-26.04 runner ships Node 24 and automated-release.yml has no setup-node step (#507). Hold at 25.x; remove once the workflow provisions Node >=26.13.
